+# ---------------- Field-Aware Factorization Machine ----------------
+class FFM:
+    """Each feature gets F separate k-dim embeddings, one per interacting field.
+    V has shape (dim, F, k): V[x, f] is the vector feature x uses when interacting with field f.
+    """
+    def __init__(self, dim, n_fields, k=4, lr=0.001, l2=1e-6, seed=0):
+        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
+        self.F = n_fields
+        self.V = rng.normal(0, 0.01, (dim, n_fields, k)).astype(np.float32)
+        self.W = np.zeros(dim, dtype=np.float32)
+        self.b = np.float32(0.0)
+        self.lr, self.l2 = lr, l2
+        self.mV = np.zeros_like(self.V); self.vV = np.zeros_like(self.V)
+        self.mW = np.zeros_like(self.W); self.vW = np.zeros_like(self.W)
+        self.t = 0
+
+    def logits(self, X):
+        # X: (B, F). E[b, i, f, :] = embedding of feature at field i, used when interacting with field f
+        E = self.V[X]                                    # (B, F, F, k) -- E[b,i,:,:] = V[X[b,i], :, :]
+        B = X.shape[0]; F = self.F
+        inter = np.zeros(B, dtype=np.float32)
+        # sum over pairs i<j of dot(V[x_i, j], V[x_j, i])
+        for i in range(F):
+            for j in range(i + 1, F):
+                vi = E[:, i, j, :]   # feature i's vector toward field j
+                vj = E[:, j, i, :]   # feature j's vector toward field i
+                inter += np.sum(vi * vj, axis=1)
+        lin = self.W[X].sum(1)
+        return self.b + lin + inter, E
+
+    def step(self, X, y):
+        B = len(y); F = self.F
+        z, E = self.logits(X)
+        g = ((sigmoid(z) - y) / B).astype(np.float32)     # (B,)
+        gV = np.zeros_like(self.V); gW = np.zeros_like(self.W)
+        np.add.at(gW, X, g[:, None])
+        # gradient wrt V[X[b,i], j] for j != i: g[b] * E[b, j, i, :]  (from term dot(V[x_i,j], V[x_j,i]))
+        for i in range(F):
+            for j in range(F):
+                if i == j: continue
+                # contribution to V[X[:,i], j] comes from partner field j's feature's vector toward field i
+                partner_vec = E[:, j, i, :]                  # (B,k)
+                np.add.at(gV, (X[:, i], np.full(B, j)), g[:, None] * partner_vec)
